capabilities: Embed files outside the vault using virtual directory paths
Create inline links that open external files with system default applications
Map local directories to per-device virtual directory IDs
Insert embeds and links via commands and a file picker
Embed folders and filter listed files
disambiguation: Not about web or internet embeds; it embeds and links local files stored outside the vault.
extras: Distributing the plugin requires including Apache 2.0 license notices because it bundles PDF.js.
intentEvidence: Embed external files (Markdown, PDF, Images, Audio, Video) outside your obsidian vault.
problem: Obsidian embeds and links only work well for files inside the vault, so referencing local files outside it breaks across devices and operating systems.

relations.evidence: This project uses PDF.js for PDF rendering, which is made available under the Apache License 2.0.

summary: Embed and link files stored outside the vault using virtual directory paths that resolve differently per device and platform.
